title: RAG-RewardBench: Benchmarking Reward Models in Retrieval Augmented Generation for Preference Alignment
authors: Zhuoran Jin; Hongbang Yuan; Tianyi Men; Pengfei Cao; Yubo Chen; Kang Liu; Jun Zhao
